Summary.Name: CIED-AI
Summary.Description: CIED-AI is a deep learning model designed to detect and classify cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) from chest X-ray images.

Mechanism.Outcome: Detection and classification of cardiac implantable electronic devices
Mechanism.Output: Device type classification with confidence score and image quality assessment
Mechanism.Model_type: Multi-model system (Detection, Quality Assessment, and Device Type Classification)

Detection_Model.Purpose: Locates CIED devices in chest X-rays
Detection_Model.Output: Bounding box coordinates and detection scores

Quality_Model.Output: Quality score on a scale of 0-4

Device_Type_Model.Output: Device type classification with confidence score

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Automated detection and classification of CIEDs from chest X-rays
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: Patients with implanted cardiac devices requiring device identification or verification
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Ensure chest X-ray image is of sufficient quality and properly positioned

Warnings_and_limitations.Image_Quality: Model performance depends on X-ray image quality
Warnings_and_limitations.Multiple_Devices: System can detect multiple devices in a single image
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Classifications should be verified when confidence scores are low
